name: Sayagatari - Youtou no Yakusoku -
original_name: サヤガタリ-妖刀の約束-
source:
"At this rate, you will die in seven days."

Ex-Kendo practitioner Kanemori Tōya has dispelled the seal on the forbidden shrine, leading to his meeting with Saya, a girl carrying a sword.

Being obsessed with swords, he unconsciously reached out for the blade, but... it was a cursed blade that awakened in him an urge to murder.

What ended up saving him was a kiss from Saya!?

"Please work with me to destroy the demonic blades"

Saya's kiss had the special power to undo the curse.

The two deepen their bond as they live together under one roof, using the demonic blade to battle the demons in their path.

However, the meaning behind the kiss seemed to be slowly changing?

Getting plenty of kisses from a beauty while becoming a demonic blade wielder, an unforgettable romantic experience is about to begin.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4520490/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“照这样下去，你将在七天后死去。”

曾习剑道的少年钟守刀哉解开了禁忌祠堂的封印，并由此邂逅了佩刀少女咲夜。

痴迷刀剑的他不由自主地伸手触碰了那把刀，然而……那竟是一把会唤醒内心杀戮冲动的妖刀。

最终拯救了他的，竟然是咲夜的一吻！？

“请与我联手，将妖刀尽数破坏吧。”

咲夜的吻拥有解除诅咒的特殊力量。

两人在同一屋檐下开启了同居生活，一边挥舞妖刀斩除挡路的妖魔，一边不断加深彼此的羁绊。

然而，“接吻”背后所蕴含的意义似乎也在悄然发生改变？

在化身为妖刀使的同时，收获来自美少女的无数亲吻——一场难以忘怀的恋爱物语即将拉开帷幕。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4520490/]Steam[/url]]
